notablePrerequisites:
"Zombie" or "Centaur" chosen with Morophon.
Liliana has at least three loyalty counters.
description:
Activate Liliana by removing three loyalty counters from it, allowing you to cast Zombie cards from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Accursed Centaur either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Accursed Centaur enters the battlefield, sacrificing itself.
Repeat from step 2.
